# Noah Laratta

> Software engineer and founder of Laratta Labs, an AI-native software studio in Denver. Builds full-stack web and mobile apps, the cloud infrastructure behind them, and AI systems and agents — scoped and shipped to production end to end.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://noahlaratta.com): overview, featured work, and current focus.
- [About](https://noahlaratta.com/about): background, technical expertise, and experience (Laratta Labs, PSIA-AASI, Lockheed Martin).
- [Projects](https://noahlaratta.com/projects): every project, filterable by category, each with its own page.
- [Lab](https://noahlaratta.com/lab): research, learning explorations, and development-workflow write-ups.

## Projects
- [SquadUp](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/squadup): social fitness platform, native iOS app with a GraphQL backend and Stripe payouts; live on the App Store (Laratta Labs).
- [YardPaint](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/yardpaint): consumer AI app that previews a landscaped yard from a photo; live on the App Store (Laratta Labs).
- [Architect](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/architect): Minecraft mod where Claude designs buildings as parametric code (open source).
- [Local Lab](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/local-lab): desktop app for comparing local AI models on Apple Silicon (open source).
- [Hunyuan3D for Blender on Mac](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/blender-hunyuan3d): textured 3D generation in Blender on Apple Silicon (open source).
- [claude-helpers](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/claude-helpers): Claude Code skills, including recovering lost work from transcripts.
- [Idea Battleground](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/idea-battleground): AI agents generate, judge and battle product ideas in Elo rounds, visualized live (open source).
- [Progression Compass](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/progression-compass): Terraria mod that recommends what to craft, farm and fight next (open source).
- [HIG Review](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/hig-review): MCP server and Claude Code plugin for reviewing Apple-platform UI against the Human Interface Guidelines, with live-cited rules (open source).
- [Lab UI](https://noahlaratta.com/projects/lab-ui): shared Fabric client UI library for the Laratta Labs Minecraft mods (open source).

## Writing
- [Getting the Most Out of Oh My Pi](https://noahlaratta.com/lab/oh-my-pi): a hands-on guide to the omp terminal coding agent — features, model routing, and workflows — plus running it 100% locally on DeepSeek V4 Flash.
